name: Space Station: Ouroboros (HYS version)
description: Due to sheer difference in responsibilities compared to when I was working with a team to working on it solo: I am spliting SS: Ouroboros between the two (Also gives me the opportunity to talk about it more
contribution: Created all but one of the tilemaps for the levels
Designed and implemented the two flying drone enemies
notes: It's an interesting experience to go back to this version of the project, I can really see why I wanted to continue this after everyone moved onto other things

This is the project that really gave me confidence that I can be a good artist. The docking bay tileset in particular is one I've grown SUPER attached to, which is probably why it was the first area I completely reworked when I got my hands on it compeletly
